proposal.hypothesis: A portable 64-bit high-bit mask can skip complete ASCII blocks throughout the buffer. For mixed blocks, scalar-decode through the block boundary and any crossing code point, avoiding both repeated per-byte ASCII checks and the prior full bit-plane classifier's boundary bookkeeping. This hybrid may help when complete ASCII blocks occur often; dense mixed-width data may instead pay the mask-check overhead.

retained: Retained the supplied scalar UTF-8 validator as validate_utf8_scalar.
Added a portable 64-bit high-bit test, loaded with memcpy, to skip complete ASCII blocks without alignment or endianness assumptions.
For mixed blocks, decoded scalar code points through the block boundary so sequences crossing it are validated once without carried state.
Used the scalar validator for the bounded tail and preserved the run ABI and output.
